description: Call this when the user asks which grants, rebates, tax credits or loans they can get to BUY, RENOVATE, SAVE ENERGY, ADAPT a home (seniors, disability), lower PROPERTY TAXES, or BUILD/RENT housing anywhere in Canada. Returns the programs in force for a province (federal + provincial + energy utilities) and, when `ville` is given, that city's municipal programs: amount, status, key conditions, published stacking rule, official page and verification date. ~800 programs, each checked on the agency's official page within the last 30 days; a status the agency does not state is flagged as inferred. Payotte does not confirm eligibility — the user applies to the agency.

inclure_fermees.description: Also return programs that are closed. Default false.

lang.description: Language of the labels. Default fr.

projet.description: acheter (buy), renover (renovate), energie (energy), adapter (accessibility/seniors), taxes (property taxes), construire (new construction/rental). Optional: all projects if omitted.

province.description: Province or territory, e.g. "Québec", "ON", "British Columbia". Required.

ville.description: City, to add its municipal programs, e.g. "Montréal", "Toronto", "Saskatoon". Optional.

name: aides_habitation
title: Aides et subventions à l'habitation au Canada / Canadian housing grants and rebates
